integrity: Proof is analytic; nine finite graph fixtures and a periodic grid fixture are independently replayable from checker.py. Classic centered-flux energy uniqueness and graph bipartiteness are attributed; only the complete common transport-invariant classification and mixing floor are assessed here.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; simple 2-vertex-connected mesh graph; full algebraic divergence-free face-circulation envelope for the complete common-kernel classification. Bipartite invariant survives restrictions to smaller control families. No physical controllability claim on nonbipartite grids, nor extension to noncentral/viscous fluxes.
title: Bipartite mesh invariants and a sharp mixing floor for centered finite-volume transport
